text: The property appears compliant regarding forests based on the available Earth-observation evidence. No tree-cover loss events of 0.5 hectares or larger were detected within the asset between 2021 and 2025. Small patches of loss (0.4 ha in 2021) were observed but are below the minimum detectable threshold. All historical loss events (e.g., 67.7 ha in 2020) occurred before the 2020 baseline, so they do not impact current compliance. The assessment does not establish regulatory compliance directly (e.g., EUDR), but the data supports no post-baseline deforestation within detectable limits.
